record.question: All of the following statements are correct about potassium balance except:
options: Three quarters of total body potassium is found in skeletal muscles
Acidosis leads to movement of potassium from extracellular to intracellular fluid compartment
Intracellular potassium is released into extracellular space in response to sever injury
record.explanation: Answer C: Acidosis leads to movement of potassium from extracellular to intracellular fluid compartment. The listed exception reverses the usual transcellular direction: mineral metabolic acidosis can shift potassium out of cells and raise extracellular potassium. The size of the shift depends on the type of acidosis and clinical context; “sever” is printed spelling. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK543705/; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38344733/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
